tieuDeEn: Our parents' kindness is as wide as the sea and as high as the mountains – so how can a young child repay it? Filial love takes a whole life, and for now we begin by following our teachers' good advice.

dichXuoi.vi: Biển thì rộng, núi thì cao, ơn cha mẹ lớn biết bao nhiêu. Làm tròn chữ hiếu thật khó – vậy báo hiếu thế nào đây?
dichXuoi.en: The sea is wide, the mountains are high, and our parents' kindness is just as great. Being truly filial is hard – so how should we repay them?

dichXuoi.vi: Đạo hiếu rộng như biển, cả đời người con cũng chưa dễ làm trọn. Chúng mình còn nhỏ, nên hãy làm theo lời thầy cô dạy bảo – điều đó thật hay.
dichXuoi.en: Filial love is as wide as the sea; even a whole life is not enough to fulfil it. We are still young, so let's follow our teachers' advice – how wise it is.

baiHocEn: Our parents' kindness is as wide as the sea and as high as the mountains. Filial love is a lifelong duty. While young, we repay it by listening to our teachers and being good.
viecTot: Tuần này, mỗi ngày đi học về em kể cho bố mẹ nghe một điều hay thầy cô đã dạy.
en: Cô Hà welcomes you to lesson sixteen of “Lên Tám” by the poet Tản Đà. Last time we thought about our parents' kindness, as high as the mountains and as wide as the sea. Today we'll look for the answer to a question every child wonders about: how can an eight-year-old repay such great kindness? Sit up nicely and listen to today's two verses.
The sea is wide, the mountains high – how great that kindness is! How hard it is to be filial – how should we repay them?
Filial love is as wide as the sea – not easy even in a whole life; we are still young children – how wise the teacher's words are.

The poem stresses again that our parents' love and sacrifice have no limit. Facing such great kindness, the child in the poem asks: how can I repay them? You can't earn money yet or carry heavy loads for your parents, so how can you fulfil your duty? This question shows the precious worry of a good child who always thinks of their parents.

The next verse shows a very simple path. Fulfilling filial love takes a whole life, not a day or two. Because you are still young and can't understand everything on your own, the first key is to listen to your teachers. They guide you from the smallest things: listening, answering politely, studying hard. When you follow their teaching and become a good child and a good student, that is the best possible start to repaying your parents.
